Name: Joja Groceries Upgrade (1.6 compatible)
Author: TaisceRayne
Description:
[size=3]This mod adds the following to the [size=3]bottom[/size] of the Joja sale menu:[/size]

[u]Sprinklers:
[/u][list]
[*]Pressure Nozzles
[*]Enrichers
[*]Sprinklers
[*]Quality Sprinklers
[*]Iridium Sprinklers
[/list][u]
Food:[/u][list]
[*]Wheat Flour
[*]Rice
[*]Sugar
[*]Oil
[*]Vinegar
[*]White Egg
[*]Large White Egg
[*]Milk
[*]Large Milk
[*]Goat Milk
[*]Large Goat Milk
[*]Cheese
[*]Goat Cheese
[*]Mayonnaise
[*]Pizza
[*]Bread
[*]Tortilla
[*]Ice Cream
[*]Field Snack (bc let's be real, it's a granola bar)
[/list]
[u]Produce:[/u]
[list]
[*]Parsnip
[*]Green Bean
[*]Cauliflower
[*]Potato
[*]Kale
[*]Garlic
[*]Carrots
[*]Rhubarb
[*]Strawberry
[*]Melon
[*]Tomato
[*]blueberry
[*]Hot Pepper
[*]Radish
[*]Hops
[*]Corn
[*]Red Cabbage
[*]Starfruit
[*]Summer Squash
[*]Eggplant
[*]Pumpkin
[*]Bok Choy
[*]Yam
[*]Cranberry
[*]Grape
[*]Artichoke
[*]Beet
[*]Broccoli
[*]Powdermelon
[*]Apple
[*]Apricot
[*]Banana
[*]Cherry
[*]Mango Orange Peach
[*]Pomegranate
[*]Ancient Fruit
[*]Cactus Fruit
[*]Pineapple
[*]Sweet Gem Berry
[*]Taro Root
[*]Coffee Bean
[*]Tea Leaves
[/list]
[u]Fertilizer:[/u]
[list]
[*]Basic Fertilizer
[*]Quality Fertilizer
[*]Deluxe Fertilizer
[*]Basic Retaining Soil
[*]Quality Retaining Soil
[*]Speed Gro
[*]Deluxe Speed Gro
[*]Hyper Speed Gro
[*]Tree Fertilizer
[/list]
[u]Misc:[/u]
[list]
[*]Grass Starter
[*]Bouquet
[*]Wilted Bouquet
[/list]
All prices are based on the iridium sale price of the item (so they're hella overcharging for those soggy basic strawberries), and are easily configurable using GMCM. All products are buyable starting in year 1!

[size=4][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size]
No known issues with any other mods. If you have a mod that completely overrides the Joja shop list then I could see those conflicting.

[size=4][b]To Install:[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]! Just drag this bad boy into your mods folder and you should be good to go! If you want to change the prices, you can edit the config.json or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to edit it right in your game!

[size=4][b]To Uninstall:[/b][/size]
Delete it! Shouldn't cause any issues in current playthroughs, it only touches the Joja shop.

[size=4][b]Recommended Mods[/b][/size]:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20985]Self-Serve[/url] to access the shop even when no one is there
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20648]Friendships Affect Prices[/url] for obvious reasons (if you have SVE)
Pierre Shop Upgrade to add all seeds, sprinklers, and sprinkler attachments to Pierre's shop (coming soon!)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26961]Robin Sells Machines[/url] to add most machines and materials to Robin's shop
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27102]Clint Shop Overhaul[/url] for machines that felt they fit Clint's shop more
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27249]Willy Sells Fish Machines[/url] for machines that felt they fit Willy's shop more
